title: Emergent chiral and topological nanoarchitectonics in self-assembled supramolecular systems
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,5516-5550
DOI: 10.1039/D2CS00259K, Review Article
Han-Xiao Wang, Xuefeng Zhu, Minghua Liu
This review summarizes the advancements in emergent chiral and topological nanoarchitectonics within self-assembled supramolecular systems, focusing on design concepts, formation mechanisms and potential applications to guide future research.
